name: When is the best time to schedule rental preparation repairs?

mainEntity.name: When is the best time to schedule rental preparation repairs?

acceptedAnswer.text: The best time to schedule rental preparation repairs is immediately after your current tenants vacate and before a new lease is signed. This minimizes vacancy periods and allows sufficient time for necessary repairs and cleaning without inconveniencing new tenants. If possible, having a buffer period between tenants is ideal. For extensive work, scheduling during off-peak rental seasons might provide more flexibility. We recommend contacting us as soon as you know your property will be vacant.
acceptedAnswer.description: Schedule repairs immediately after current tenants vacate and before a new lease, ideally with a buffer period, to minimize vacancy and inconvenience.
